meaning:
ἐκ-φύω
[in OT (Sm.) Psa.104:14; (Al.) Isa.61:11 * ;]
to cause to grow out, put forth (leaves): Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
